title: Freelance writing
facts: People who write well in Tamil or English can earn by writing blogs, website copy and ad lines for clients.
Freelance marketplaces such as Upwork and Fiverr connect writers with clients; fees and payment methods differ by platform.
Beginners usually start with small paid tasks and build a portfolio of samples.
Copying other people's writing is plagiarism, and freelance income is taxable in India, so keep records.

title: Design work with Canva
facts: Simple design tools like Canva let beginners make posters, logos and social media graphics.
A portfolio page on Instagram or Behance helps show samples to potential clients.
Small shops and local businesses often need posters, menus and social media designs.
Use only licensed images and fonts, otherwise the client can face copyright problems.

title: Video editing
facts: Reels creators and YouTubers often hire editors for cutting, captions and thumbnails.
Beginners can practise with free editing apps and build three or four sample videos.
Editors usually find first clients by contacting small creators directly and showing samples.
Meeting deadlines and communicating clearly is what brings repeat orders.

title: Building websites for small businesses
facts: Many local shops and small businesses still have no website.
A beginner can learn WordPress or basic web development and build a demo site to show clients.
Domain, hosting and monthly maintenance can give recurring income.
Get the scope in writing and take an advance before starting work.

title: Translation work
facts: People who know Tamil and English well can offer translation for subtitles, websites and documents.
There is steady demand for Tamil subtitles and localisation for videos and apps.
A few sample translations make a simple portfolio for new clients.
Pasting raw machine translation without checking hurts quality and your reputation.

title: Voice-over work
facts: Tamil voice-over is needed for ads, YouTube videos, e-learning and audio content.
A decent microphone and a quiet room are the basic requirements for clean recordings.
Voice artists usually share a short demo reel with clients.
Never use another person's voice without their permission.

title: Social media management for local shops
facts: Many local businesses want someone to run their Instagram or Facebook page.
A free trial on one page, with before and after results, can win the first client.
Work is often billed as a fixed monthly fee.
Promise only what you can deliver and explain clearly what you will do.

title: Online tutoring
facts: People who explain well can teach school subjects, spoken English or software skills online.
Start with friends and acquaintances, then move to tutoring platforms or your own batches.
Choose the subject you know best and fix regular class timings.
For children, get parents' permission and keep classes transparent and safe.

title: Selling an online course
facts: A skill you know well can be packaged as a recorded course.
Pick one narrow topic and teach it step by step in short videos.
Courses can be listed on platforms such as Udemy or sold directly to your own audience.
Income is not instant, but one course can keep selling for a long time.

title: Selling digital products
facts: Templates, study notes and planners are digital products made once and sold many times.
The best products solve a specific problem for a specific group of people.
They can be promoted on Instagram or Telegram and delivered as files.
Copying someone else's content to sell it creates copyright problems.

title: YouTube channel
facts: A YouTube channel can earn from ads, memberships, sponsorships and affiliate links.
Choose one topic and upload consistently, for example two or three videos a week.
YouTube sets minimum requirements before a channel can earn from ads, and these rules change over time.
Most channels earn nothing for the first several months, so patience matters.

title: Blogging and ad income
facts: A blog can earn from display ads, affiliate links and sponsored posts.
Choose one topic and write genuinely useful, original articles.
Ad programmes such as Google AdSense have approval rules and content policies.
Growth takes months, and copied content can get an account banned.

title: Instagram Reels and brand collaborations
facts: Creators who build an engaged audience in one niche can work with brands.
Niches such as food, tech and fashion are common starting points.
Even small creators can pitch small local brands directly.
Paid promotions must be disclosed clearly under advertising rules.

title: Affiliate marketing
facts: Affiliate marketers earn a commission when someone buys through their tracked link.
Programmes such as Amazon Associates India provide links after you join.
Honest reviews of products you have actually used build audience trust.
Affiliate links must be disclosed; hiding them breaks programme rules.

title: Reselling products
facts: Reselling means selling other suppliers' products and keeping the margin, often without holding stock.
Reselling apps and WhatsApp groups are common ways to find customers.
Your profit is the price you add, so price carefully.
Plan for returns, delivery delays and customer complaints in advance.

title: Home tiffin and meals service
facts: People who cook well can supply tiffin or meals to offices, hostels and neighbours.
Nearby offices, hostels and PG accommodations are natural first customers.
Food businesses in India need FSSAI registration or a licence depending on their size.
Hygiene, taste and punctuality bring repeat customers through word of mouth.

title: Homemade pickle, podi and snacks brand
facts: Homemade pickles, podis and snacks have a steady market in India.
Start small, give samples to people you know and collect honest feedback.
Good packaging, a clear label and a brand name help you sell online too.
FSSAI rules and correct label information must be followed.

title: Handmade crafts and jewellery
facts: Handmade jewellery, decor and gift items sell well online and at exhibitions.
Clear product photos on Instagram help attract orders.
Price should cover materials, your time and a profit margin.
Weekly markets and craft fairs are another way to sell locally.

title: Event photography
facts: Events such as weddings, birthdays and functions need photographers.
Build a portfolio by shooting friends' and family events first.
Editing and album design can be added as paid services.
Write down deliverables and delivery dates in an agreement.

title: Mobile phone repair
facts: Phones always need repairs, which makes repair a steady skill-based trade.
Get proper training and work in a repair shop first to gain experience.
Screen and battery replacements are common, quick jobs.
Use good quality spare parts and respect customers' personal data.

title: Delivery partner (part-time)
facts: Food and parcel delivery apps hire part-time delivery partners.
A valid driving licence and vehicle documents are required.
Earnings depend on the number of orders, and fuel and maintenance costs must be subtracted.
Wear a helmet and ride safely; safety matters more than speed.

title: Ride-hailing driver
facts: Ride-hailing apps let drivers earn by taking trips in their own or leased vehicles.
Commercial vehicle permits, licence and insurance rules must be checked first.
Peak hours usually pay more, but fuel and maintenance reduce the take-home income.
Fatigue is dangerous; rest is part of the job.

title: Selling used items
facts: Unused items at home such as phones, furniture and books can be sold for cash.
Marketplaces such as OLX and Facebook Marketplace let you list items with photos and a price.
Meet buyers in a public place and prefer safe payment methods.
Never share OTPs or PINs; buyers who ask for them are scammers.

title: Excel and data work for small businesses
facts: Small businesses need help with billing sheets, stock lists and monthly accounts in Excel.
Start with tasks you already know well, such as billing and stock tracking.
One good template can be adapted for many shops.
Any data-entry job that asks you to pay a registration fee is a scam.

title: Upskill to raise your salary
facts: If you already have a job, learning an in-demand skill can raise your earning power.
Pick a skill with clear demand in job listings and practise a little every day.
Turn what you learn into a small project and add it to your resume.
In salary discussions, describe your work with concrete results and numbers.

title: Make a budget
facts: Controlling spending matters as much as earning more.
A common rule of thumb splits income into needs, wants and savings, for example 50, 30 and 20 percent.
It is only a guideline; adjust it to your own situation.
Tracking expenses for one month shows where money is leaking.

title: Build an emergency fund
facts: An emergency fund covers job loss, medical bills or sudden repairs.
A common guideline is three to six months of essential expenses.
Keep it in an easy-access savings account.
Do not put emergency money into risky investments that can lose value.

title: Investing through SIP
facts: A Systematic Investment Plan invests a fixed amount regularly into a mutual fund.
Mutual fund returns are linked to markets, are not guaranteed, and can be negative.
Complete KYC and invest only through regulated platforms.
SIP is for long-term goals; it is not a way to get rich quickly.

title: Scam alert: money doubling schemes
facts: Schemes promising to double your money or guarantee high returns are a major red flag.
No legitimate investment can guarantee high returns with no risk.
Schemes that pay you mainly for recruiting new members are pyramid or Ponzi structures.
Before investing, verify registration with SEBI or RBI, as applicable.

title: Scam alert: task jobs and loan apps
facts: WhatsApp or Telegram jobs that pay you to like videos or complete tasks are commonly scams.
Any job that asks you to pay money before you start is a red flag.
Use only loan apps from lenders regulated by RBI, and be careful about apps asking for contacts and photos.
Report cyber fraud quickly on the national helpline 1930 or at cybercrime.gov.in.
